_comment: Rule catalogue for the 'OLM SF-8M BOM' template sheet. 'value' is a takeoff key or an expression over takeoff keys, evaluated per Grant/Non-Grant column. status: VERIFIED (reproduces the NMK reference from independent sources), INFERRED (defensible rule, reference partly differs or rule not fully provable), TEMPLATE_FORMULA (template formula kept), UNRESOLVED (no reliable source - left blank and flagged), SUGGESTED (computed for the audit only; reference left blank), NOT_DETECTED (no drawing symbol identified - left blank and flagged). Only rules with write=true put numbers in the BOM.

rows.label: Total Route Mileage
rows.basis: (UG trench + aerial strand route-footage labels CX1-FTG-N2) / 5280, split by Non-Grant polygons

rows.label: Aerial Footage
rows.basis: sum of CX1-FTG-N2 FTG labels on RTE_AESTRAND

rows.label: UG Footage
rows.basis: sum of CX1-FTG-N2 FTG labels on RTE_UGTRENCH (fiber-bearing route)

rows.label: Total Drop Footage
rows.basis: FX_DROPS drop lines (RTE_SpatialNet_UGDROP, ped edge to address PED, CX1-FTG-N2 length). Area = served address. Reference convention: Non-Grant column = Non-Grant drops ('total - grant'), Grant column 0; grant drops shown in the audit (drop_ft)

rows.label: Residential Count
rows.basis: sum HC of CX1-COUNT (minus MDU units); grant = FMRESADD2 on GRANTADDRESS layer; cross-checked with address list

rows.label: Commercial Count
rows.basis: sum CC of CX1-COMCNT (+unused MDUC) minus MDU commercial units; grant = FMCOMADD2 outside Non-Grant polygons

rows.label: MDU Count
rows.basis: FMMULTIADD RESIDENTIAL_COUNT + COMMERCIAL_COUNT by area
